courses.title: The Embodiment How-To Manual and Workbook
courses.description: A downloadable workbook of more than 50 pages by Stephanie Red Feather on embodiment, which she describes as giving your spirit a home. It explains why people leave their bodies, what spiritual bypass is and how to return, with self-assessments, journaling questions and practices to come back to over time.

left_out: Shamanic Breathwork sessions (/shamanicbreathwork): the page says breathwork reaches what 'many other therapies can't come close to' and that it can help when blocked by addictions; read as setting it in place of therapy, so left out under the caller's even-indirect rule.
Embodiment manual plus 45-minute coaching session: a separate product page for the same manual; one item kept.
